verdict.rationale: Lovable documents a feature it calls the "Lovable API Build with URL." It creates links that open Lovable with a prompt and optional reference images or pages pre-attached, so it is a documented public entry point for starting a build. It is only a launch link that opens the UI, though, and a probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any standard path. The Lovable MCP server belongs to a separate MCP-server story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: a programmatic REST/HTTP API with documented endpoints for managing projects, sending messages and deploying; authentication/API keys; a published API reference or OpenAPI spec; and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Lovable API Build with URL feature lets you create links that open Lovable with a prompt already written, and optionally with reference images and web pages attached.
